syndromes.title: Invasive fusariosis
rows: IV 6 mg/kg BID on day 1, then 4 mg/kg BID from day 2; use TDM
Continue until host-defence recovery; disseminated disease: minimum 2 months moderately recommended
Hoenigl 2021 Rare Mould Suppl | Fig 5 | PDF p32
Salvage options in this syndrome: Switch antifungal class according to prior therapy
Largest series: 90-day survival 53% with voriconazole vs 48% with lipid AmB and 27% with AmB-d.

Figure-reported ranges: ABLC 3–5 mg/kg/day OR L-AmB 3–10 mg/kg/day. Guideline text states that a formal recommendation for the exact dose of either lipid formulation cannot be made because of broad dose ranges and limited patient numbers.
Continue until host-defence recovery; disseminated disease: minimum 2 months

Salvage options in this syndrome: Switch antifungal class according to prior therapy

Lipid formulations are strongly supported as primary treatment options, but the guideline explicitly does NOT make a formal recommendation for one exact lipid-AmB dose. AmB-d should not be used when other active agents are available.
